qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md assignment constraints via prompts/29.md; qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/raw-evidence-index.json (sha256 5f5a4c39...; scope: no configured judge run, render not covered by scripted golden)
evidence: Gate dimensions carry the real gate: scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0 with all_pass aggregation (gates/render/judge.toml:17-18, gates/constraints/judge.toml:51-52). Render gate criterion authenticated_render (render/judge.toml:25-34) requires a real Kittle & Rowe matter chat (not blank/static mock/error), nothing private before sign-in, wrong password rejected, and gwen opens her matters; constraints gate server_backed_local_application (constraints/judge.toml:59-71) adds the backing leg: Gwen posts JUDGE-G1 in M-11, reload shows it, and harriet in a separate browser context sees it, so a static shell or localStorage-only facade fails. Each scored prompt restates the in-dimension gate with hard zero: functional/prompt.md:11-19, polish/prompt.md:10-18, visual/prompt.md:18-26 ('If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension'), covering blank page, empty workspace, static mock/shell, missing backend, sign-in for gwen and server-backed real data; polish:27-28 and visual:42-43 say the gate is the only all-or-nothing rule; functional individual mode (judge.toml:6) re-applies the gate per criterion session. No prompt or gate requires same-origin: gates explicitly allow external font/script/CDN requests (render/prompt.md:12-13, constraints/prompt.md:13-14, constraints/judge.toml:62-64); the only 'origin' mention (functional/prompt.md:44-45, app_context.md:27) is the judge's replay technique, not a requirement on the app. The Internal sheet D30 wording 'cross-origin apps' is historical and superseded by the public-network posture in SKILL.md:26 and the public row text. Gate account gwen is never walled by functional criteria (walls only touch dev/sian), so the polish/visual gate remains satisfiable after the functional run. Adversarial: a static HTML shell with a fake login and client-only storage fails the constraints cross-context persistence leg; a conforming app using CDN assets or a differently structured API is not penalized. Limits: this is source review; no configured judge run exists for these bytes and the scripted golden did not cover render (raw-evidence-index scope), so actual gate pass on the golden is not measured here; that gap belongs to runtime rows, not to this design check.
